comment: I absolutely loved him as a teacher. He pushed me to think in a way I never had before. I learned a lot and fell in love with philosophy.
Would not recommend to a friend

Confused as to why his ratings are so high, he is not as easy as he makes himself sound. Definitely bias and his pop quizzes are ridiculous. Positive note: midterm and final are straightford. Paper is very confusing. And students grade your presentations which is kind of weird.

Professor Abaci gives good  examples that support the readings that are assigned for homework so you can understand the concepts and arguments addressed in the book, he makes you think before you speak. He will push you and challenge you in class discussions. The readings were also really interesting!

One of my best professors so far here at UR. You are required to read texts each night; however, they are very interesting and definitely worth reading. The next day in class he goes over exactly what you read from the night before and clarifies any misconceptions. I was between 3-4 stars for easiness, but if you do the readings you will do well.
